mintAuthority.summary: bbqUSDC is an immutable MetaMorpho ERC-4626 vault (no EIP-1967 proxy slots); shares are minted only against USDC deposits. Vault owner is the Steakhouse Safe v1.4.1 8/5. Base USDC issuance is inherited from Circle.

controls.label: Smokehouse USDC MetaMorpho vault (immutable, deposit-only mint)

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25358823: asset() returned USDC (0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48); EIP-1967 proxy_admin and implementation slots both returned zero; owner() returned 0x0a0e559bc3b0950a7e448f0d4894db195b9cf8dd. That Safe returned 8 owners, threshold=5, and getModulesPaginated returned no modules.

controls.label: Inherited Ethereum USDC MasterMinter
controls.evidence: Inherited from reviewed usdc-circle parent; base USDC issuance is Circle-controlled.

review.evidence: RPC and explorer review confirmed an immutable MetaMorpho vault over USDC, deposit-only wrapper minting, and Steakhouse Safe ownership (8 owners, threshold 5, no modules returned). Durable base-asset mint authority remains with Circle USDC.

collateral: USDC deposited into Steakhouse's Smokehouse MetaMorpho vault, allocated across Morpho Blue lending markets that intentionally include wider and more exotic borrower collateral than Steakhouse's Prime line
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 MetaMorpho vault shares appreciate against USDC as borrower interest accrues; withdrawals redeem shares for available USDC liquidity or wait for Morpho market liquidity to return

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: bbqUSDC is tracked as one Ethereum MetaMorpho vault token. The reviewed Steakhouse and Morpho source set does not show a durable bridge route for this vault share.
